description: This file defines the React component for the Applicant Portal UI, including functionality for managing loan application drafts, uploading documents, and application submission workflows. It includes components like ApplicantPortal, DraftsPanel, DocumentsPanel, and SubmitPanel, along with utility functions and CSS styling.

methods.name: prettyJson
methods.description: Formats a value as pretty-printed JSON, with error handling.

methods.name: safeJsonStr
methods.description: Converts a value into a JSON string, with error handling.

methods.name: shortId
methods.description: Returns last 6 characters of an ID in uppercase for display.

methods.name: statusTheme
methods.description: Returns color scheme based on application status string.

methods.name: addToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message for user feedback.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an async function with loading state and error handling.

methods.name: fetchDrafts
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of application drafts.

methods.name: fetchDocs
methods.description: Fetches documents linked to a specific draft.

methods.name: doCreateDraft
methods.description: Creates a new draft and selects it.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Uploads a document file linked to the selected draft.

methods.name: doCheckReadiness
methods.description: Checks whether the application is ready for submission based on sections and documents.

methods.name: doDecide
methods.description: Runs the decisioning process on the draft.

methods.name: doLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login.
